title: A DEFINE VAR variable can be used in every EVALUATE of the query
query: EVALUATE FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Product[Color] ), "Amount", [Sales Amount] ), [Amount] >= MinimumAmount )

source.quote: One DEFINE can be applied to one or more EVALUATE statements.
source.supports: the page shows one query variable used in two EVALUATE statements

source.quote: Definitions in the DEFINE statement can apply to any EVALUATE statements in the query.
source.supports: definitions are shared by the EVALUATE statements

derivation: First result: Red 460, Blue 80, Green BLANK; only Red is at least 100 (BLANK >= 100 is FALSE). Second result: 100 * 2 = 200.
